validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE — confirmed by two independent sources that both NAME this specific pipeline (not a generic aggregate mention): (1) VNIPItransgaz (ОАО «ИПП «ВНИПИТРАНСГАЗ», the Soviet/Russian trunk-pipeline design institute) published a table of gas-transmission projects it engineered, captured live on Wayback 2022-02-25 from the wiki-cited vtg.com.ua page (the live URL is now 404 — the wiki citation itself is dead, so I substituted the Wayback capture of the SAME page/content). The table lists a 'system of gas pipelines' comprising Shebelinka-Poltava-Kiev / Efremovka-Dikanka-Kiev / Shebelinka-Dikanka-Kiev / Kiev-West Ukraine (I and II threads), with per-line diameter/pressure/length/thread-count/countries columns. The Efremovka-Dikanka-Kiev row: diameter 1000 mm, pressure 5.4 MPa, length 477.8 km, 1 thread, country 'Ukraine' (domestic only, unlike the Russia-Ukraine cross-border trunks in the same table). (2) enovosty.com (Ekonomichni Novyny, a real Ukrainian news outlet, verified live via url_verifier), 2016-11-18, headlined 'Газопровод Ефремовка — Диканька — Киев может в любой момент стать причиной экологической катастрофы' — reporting that pharmaceutical warehouses (Universal Logistic) were built inside the pipeline's safety buffer near Velyka Oleksandrivka, Boryspil district, Kyiv Oblast (i.e. on the approach to Kiev), and quoting an environmental-NGO lawyer citing the 250 m safety-zone rule around 'the gas pipe.' The two sources are fully independent (a Soviet-era engineering-institute technical table vs. a 2016 Ukrainian environmental-news story) and both name this exact line, so existence is well supported — this is not a GEM-only or wiki-only entity. SPEC — VNIPItransgaz's numbers corroborate GEM closely: length 477.8 km vs GEM's 477.00 km (0.17% variance, consistent with source rounding, not a material disagreement) and diameter 1000 mm vs GEM's 1000 mm (exact match). Only one technical source carries the numeric spec, so tier is medium on Length/Diameter per the 2+-independent rule, but the match itself is clean — no spec concern. CLASSIFICATION — correctly a gas transmission trunk (1000 mm x 477 km domestic Ukraine trunk), not a gathering/feeder line; both sources call it 'газопровод' (gas pipeline), confirming Fuel=Gas with two independent sources (tier high). DUPLICATE — checked against the Dikanka-family roster hint (P1452/P1453/P1454/P1460). The VNIPItransgaz table itself resolves this cleanly for P1453: it lists Shebelinka-Poltava-Kiev, Efremovka-Dikanka-Kiev and Shebelinka-Dikanka-Kiev as THREE separately engineered lines within one interconnected 'system,' each with its own distinct diameter/length row (700mm/438km, 1000mm/477.8km, 1000mm/522km respectively) — P1453 is not a duplicate or relabel of P1452 or P1454, it is a genuinely distinct physical pipe that happens to share termini with its siblings. Flagging for the separate cluster-adjudication pass, NOT resolving myself: while cross-checking this table I noticed it also states Shebelinka-Dikanka-Kiev (P1454, len=522 matches GEM exactly) at 1000 mm, which conflicts with GEM's P1454 Diameter='1200, 2350' — independent corroboration of the country brief's existing suspicion that '2350' is a typo (and now also that '1200' itself may be wrong, per this second source giving 1000 mm) on that OTHER row, not this one. ATTRIBUTION — Owner1='Gas Transmission System Operator of Ukraine' 100% is consistent with the correct standing fact for all-Ukraine-domestic trunks post-2020 unbundling (state TSO, not Naftogaz's old Ukrtransgaz, and correctly NOT Gazprom, which holds no Ukrainian-territory assets) — no attribution concern — but I could not find a citable, live public source naming THIS specific ownership fact within the time budget: tsoua.com 403s our verifier/WebFetch UA on every path (home, about-us, key-facts, wp-json), and its Wayback captures of the key-facts page are empty client-rendered SPA shells with no static text. fills.researcher_notes: 2016-11-18 Ukrainian news story treats the line as a live, in-service 'regulated object' ('режимный объект') whose safety buffer is actively enforced, and warns of consequences 'if improperly operated' — implying ongoing operation. Only one source speaks to operational status directly (VNIPItransgaz's table documents design/construction, not current status), so tier=medium; no evidence anywhere of retirement, and per the country brief the 2025 transit cutoff is not evidence against domestic operating status.
Both sources independently call this a 'газопровод' (gas pipeline) — VNIPItransgaz's table title is 'name of the trunk gas pipeline', enovosty's headline names it a gas pipeline directly.

VNIPItransgaz's design table gives 477.8 km for the Efremovka-Dikanka-Kiev line — a 0.17% variance from GEM's 477.00 km, well within source-rounding tolerance, so I'm treating this as agreement and keeping GEM's value rather than overwriting it off one source. Only one source carries a numeric length, so tier=medium (single strong source) per the corroboration rule, not a spec concern.
VNIPItransgaz's table gives exactly 1000 mm for Efremovka-Dikanka-Kiev, an exact match to GEM's value. Single-source (tier=medium) but a clean match, no discrepancy.

VNIPItransgaz's table lists this line under 'Ukraine' only (domestic, unlike the cross-border Russia-Ukraine trunks in the same table), consistent with GEM's Start/EndCountryOrArea=Ukraine/Ukraine. enovosty's 2016 report independently corroborates the route's approach into Kiev, placing it through Boryspil district, Kyiv Oblast. Did not attempt to fill blank StartPrefecture/District or EndPrefecture/District fields — a plausible lead is that 'Efremovka' is Yefremivka, Kharkiv Oblast (site of the Yefremivka gas-condensate field, a plausible source point for an eastern trunk into Kyiv, and consistent with sibling trunks in this system starting at nearby Shebelinka), but I could not verify that identification against a citable public source in the time available, so left it unfilled rather than guess.

summary: P1453 confirmed real (2 independent sources naming it directly, Soviet design-institute table + 2016 Ukrainian news story); length/diameter corroborated near-exactly by VNIPItransgaz (477.8 km vs 477.00, 1000mm exact); not a duplicate of P1452/P1454 (VNIPItransgaz shows all three as genuinely distinct lines in one system) but surfaced a likely diameter defect on sibling P1454 (VTG says 1000mm vs GEM's '1200, 2350') for the separate cluster pass; Status/Fuel/Length/Diameter/Location refs staged (REFS_ADDED); Owner [ref] left UNRESOLVED — tsoua.com blocks fetches on every path and its Wayback captures are empty SPA shells.
